edit.description: Three motions. (1) `gate_installed` (:812) stops swallowing a stale gate hook: the `SupersededByMember` arm of its skip (:831-:835) is what makes a member running a retired command read green forever, and the advisory message (:874) — "run `temper install`" — is now false on the represented path, because install never re-adds. It becomes the remedy: the member module (`.temper/<member_dir("hook")>/<stem>.ts`) and the `harness.ts` import line, the two the lift writes at :2318-:2335 and :2536-:2551. (2) The missing/stale split reads the PROJECTION, not the lock: a lock row's `fields` are dropped (`hook_claimed_events`, :1059, says so) and 0074 keeps the registration key the bare event, so the matcher that identifies the member only survives in `.claude/settings.json`. Extend `event_has_command` (:2004) and `group_has_command` (:2019) — which already walk an event's matcher groups — to answer "a group at this (event, matcher)" beside "a group carrying this command"; no third walker beside them (`specs/process/engineering.md`, "One job, one home"). `gate_hooks_wired` (:905) and `gate_outcome` (:938) consume the split. (3) `place_settings_only` (:888) is the unrepresented path's writer and must never reach a represented harness — see `src/main.rs`.

The `Represent` dispatch (:513-:522) refuses `--no-represent` only when `.temper/lock.toml` is on disk, while `gate_installed` (:816) reads representedness off `.temper/harness.ts`. A harness with a program and no lock — represented, never emitted — can still answer No, and `place_settings_only` then splices the `SessionStart` row into a file emit owns whole: install re-adding a gate hook to a represented harness, which decision 0073 forbids outright. Close it on the same reading both faces take.

`ApplyOutcome` (:2766) is the shared enumeration the split may widen — a stale spelling and a missing member are reported differently now, and `SupersededByMember` today spells only the first. If a variant joins, its `label` arm (:2782) moves with it and every match site is named here: `src/install.rs` :833, :940-:941, :2796-:2797 and `tests/it/install.rs` :34, :1708 (`specs/process/engineering.md`, "A shared concept is one type"). If the existing three variants carry it, say so in the commit body rather than widening for symmetry.

The self-verify arms: `gate_installed_never_scaffolds_and_reflects_represented_vs_not` (:1569) and the `SupersededByMember` arm (:1708) re-baseline onto the remedy wording, and gain the case the decision's Context names — a represented harness whose gate hook member runs a retired command spelling reads as stale, with the module named, rather than silent. A represented-but-lockless harness answering No places nothing.

:7 carries the advisory verbatim ("temper's gate is not installed or has drifted — run `temper install` (missing or drifted: guard hook, post-tool-use hook)") — it re-baselines onto the remedy wording.
Declared for the fence: the corpus run that produces the snapshot above. Re-baseline only if the arm itself spells the message.
:552-:576 reasons about the always-on `install.gate-installed` advisory under `--deny-advisories` — re-verify the arm and correct the comment where the wording moved.

:200-:216 drives `gate_installed` over a harness with a bare `harness.ts` and no lock — exactly the represented-but-lockless shape this entry touches. Re-verify; the arm filters on "managed-by note" and should not move.

summary: Install never re-adds a gate hook to a represented harness, and `gate_installed` names a missing OR stale one with its remedy: the member module and the harness.ts import line.

tests.asserts: a represented harness whose gate hook member runs a retired command spelling reports a stale gate hook naming that module, a harness with no member at a gate hook's (event, matcher) reports it missing with the module and import line to author, and neither run writes `.claude/settings.json`
a represented harness with a program and no lock is treated as represented by both faces — install places nothing into the projection

acceptance: cargo test green with the gauntlet diagnostics snapshot re-baselined, cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean, cargo fmt --all --check clean.
notes: Decision 0073's first ruling and its second consequence. The 'never re-adds' half is already true on the ordinary path — `run_represented` (:717) writes no settings and scaffolds only when `harness.ts` is absent — so the code owed is the remedy, the stale report, and the lockless-represented hole. Blocked on the commands entry: same scaffold and module-naming surfaces. scoped at e1bba76b
